3-Week Hybrid Training Program on 5G Essentials!

Unlock the potential of 5G technology with our "Tutorial on 5G Essentials"—a comprehensive hybrid training program combining online theory sessions with hands-on demonstrations in our state-of-the-art 5G test lab.

Explore 5G fundamentals & evolution, key technologies like MIMO, Beamforming, 5G New Radio (NR), 5G Core Network & Architecture, Real-World Applications – IoT, AI, Autonomous Vehicles, Security, challenges & future trends.

Why should you join?
-Deep dive into 5G principles & cutting-edge applications
-Develop in-demand skills for the 5G era
-Network with industry professionals & fellow learners
-Earn a certificate of completion

📅 Schedule: https://lnkd.in/gYRFjs5d
📍 Format: 2 Weeks Online + 1 Week Onsite Hands-On Training(ARTgarage, Bangalore)
Registration fee: Rs 2000/- (Inclusive of GST)

Register Now: https://lnkd.in/ghzFmsJ7
